11 games, no goal involvements: Derby County will be relieved over failed summer pursuit of £4.5m winger target

Derby County eyed Oliver Antman in their summer hunt for a new winger, but they may be relieved a deal didn’t come to the fore.
By James Ray
Championship, Transfers Correspondent · 29 September 2026
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:52
Instaread

Derby County had eyes on Finnish winger Oliver Antman in the summer transfer window, but he ended up heading to Belgium with RSC Anderlecht.

Derby County had a challenging summer with the investment deal collapse and a frustrating wait for transfers, but the Rams were able to bring a string of new players in on a positive transfer deadline day.

Newport 2–1 Grimsby | League Two highlights
Stockport 1-0 Peterborough
Sheffield Wednesday 0-0 Stockport
Accrington Stanley 0-0 Newport

York 3-0 Gillingham
Tranmere 1-1 Walsall
Swindon 1-1 Accrington
Shrewsbury 2-2 Colchester
Rotherham 1-1 Crewe
Wycombe 2-2 Reading

Going into the final hours of the window, it was abundantly clear that DCFC needed a winger. They ended up landing Mohammed Fuseini, who bagged a last-gasp equaliser in the draw with Burnley just before the international break.

Championship Roundup More Championship →
Free agent previously eyed by Blackburn Rovers poised for new move Revelation made over late £12.8m summer bid for West Ham man QPR in line for big injury boost regarding 23-year-old

However, plenty of other players were on the radar at Pride Park over the transfer window. Among them was Oliver Antman, but he swapped Rangers for Belgium’s RSC Anderlecht instead.

Oliver Antman’s Belgian struggles since Derby County links

Antman made for an intriguing Derby County target. He previously thrived in the Netherlands with Go Ahead Eagles, with his form there duly earning him the switch to Rangers in the summer of 2025.

However, the Finn didn’t live up to expectations at Ibrox as the door opened for him to depart after one goal and five assists in 28 games for the club. DCFC would have offered a chance to stay in the UK, but Antman headed for Belgium in a £4.5m deal that saw Rangers make a profit on the £3.5m they had previously spent on him.

Unfortunately for Antman, he is yet to find that desired return to form. He has played 11 times for new club Anderlecht, but is yet to contribute a goal or assist as he battles for his starting berth.

Three of his seven league outings have been starts, and he has not started in the UEFA Europa League qualifying or group stage campaign either. Antman has shown what he’s capable of at a similar level and at 25, he still has time to grow, but this early form is not ideal.

The Verdict: Derby County dodged a bullet in failed Oliver Antman interest

Antman could yet come good. As said, he’s still at a good age and he’ll hope to have a more telling impact as he continues to settle with Anderlecht.

However, if Derby County had spent £4.5m on a new winger who didn’t manage a goal contribution in their first 11 outings, there would have been justified frustrations.

Oliver Antman’s RSC Anderlecht stats

It remains to be seen if Fuseini has what it takes to be the attacking hit that DCFC need, but it does feel as though they’ve dodged a bullet a bit by not landing Antman.

The Finn will strive to prove his doubters wrong nonetheless, while the Rams focus on finding form in the Championship after the break.
